# routeros_ip_media_settings (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `thumbnails` (String) Location used by the media server for the generated thumbnails; empty by default. This is the only property `/ip/media/settings/set` accepts on RouterOS 7.23, but MikroTik does not document it, so the exact accepted values were not established.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
